title: Lithium-Ion Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction and Cascade Utilization Screening
dataBoundary: Fully simulated data with semi-empirical generation assumptions
summary: A four-part competition modeling workflow on fully simulated data with semi-empirical generation assumptions, connecting degradation-stage detection, SOH and RUL estimation, compatibility graphs, multi-objective grouping, and robust stress testing.
workflow: Q2: Ridge SOH estimation and censored Weibull AFT RUL prediction
Q3: scenario gates, compatibility graphs, and epsilon-constraint MILP
Q4: probability compatibility, stress scenarios, CVaR, and robust strategy comparison
validation: Battery-level train, validation, and test separation
Q3 member set frozen before hidden-truth audit
Independent Q4 calibration and final holdout pools
Clean-package reproduction and final validation checks
limitations: All numerical results come from fully simulated data generated with semi-empirical assumptions; no row is measured experimental data.
REU is a relative economic unit, not a currency estimate.
Proxy safety gates do not replace thermal, electrical, mechanical, or regulatory testing.
The audit covers 599 configured candidate columns within the stated candidate-generation rules.

facts.publicText: Fully simulated data with semi-empirical generation assumptions

A four-part competition modeling workflow on fully simulated data with semi-empirical generation assumptions, connecting degradation-stage detection, SOH and RUL estimation, compatibility graphs, multi-objective grouping, and robust stress testing.
418,430 generated cycle records across 360 simulated battery trajectories; no row is measured experimental data
Simulated-data result: median knee at 944 cycles and knee MAE of 60.3 cycles
Internal holdout on simulated data: SOH RMSE 0.175 percentage points; RUL MAE 49.4 cycles and RMSE 70.0 cycles
Simulated-data audit of 599 candidate columns selected F014: 18 groups, 196 cells, 40.8% utilization, and 25.53 REU net value
Simulated-data analysis calibrated p0 = 0.80; robust strategy S0 formed 6 groups with 27.5% utilization and 43.80 REU value
